cost: Bounded exhaustive enumeration only: subset/closure MST oracle, short word tree checks, or subset clique oracle. These test costs are exponential in their tiny fixed domains, not production performance measurements.
description: Execute three named deterministic tests over the actual public API. 4096 signed/absent graphs on four vertices compare independent subset enumeration and transitive closure, plus exact signed extremes, parallel ties, loops, isolates, invalid endpoints and both caps. Acceptance is conjunction of all named assertions, not a proof over unenumerated inputs.

inverse: The all-pass observation admits every implementation agreeing on sampled assertions, including ones wrong elsewhere. A failing assertion constrains the mismatching observation but need not uniquely identify a defect. Named identities preserve more information than only a count.
